Title: Aditya's Day

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pihu - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Meenakshi - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Vikram - 36 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Ayaan - 8 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Vikram stand near him.]

Aditya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Aditya (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[A light drizzle begins.]

Meenakshi: "Vikram, look at this."

[A storm breaks over the village.]

Aditya: "Dad, look at this."

[Thick fog covers the village.]

Vikram: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi, Vikram and Ayaan stand near him.]

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya walks across the courtyard.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya runs to Mother.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

[Aditya jumps with joy.]

Aditya (softly): "Okay, Dad."

[Aditya climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Ayaan (surprised): "Careful!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Pihu stand near him.]

Pihu: "What a nice place."

[Aditya takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya irons his school shirt.]

Aditya (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditya does his homework at the table.]

Aditya: "I knew it!"

[Aditya types on his laptop.]

Meenakshi: "Really?"

[Aditya opens the door and goes out.]

Aditya: "Wow, how lovely!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

Aditya: "So, here we are!"

[Aditya throws the ball to Mother.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Pihu: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya goes down the slide.]

Pihu (excited): "Let's see."

[Aditya feeds the birds.]

Aditya: "Mom, listen!"

[Aditya does push-ups.]

Aditya: "What happened?"

[Pihu skips rope.]

Pihu (surprised): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
